title: Desenvolvedor Java com AWS
description:
Desenvolvedor Java com AWS


Local: atuação remota

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Nível: Pleno


Sobre a Vaga:

Como Desenvolvedor Java com AWS, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações escaláveis e eficientes na nuvem. Você trabalhará em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções que atendam às necessidades dos nossos clientes e do negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em Java, garantindo alta qualidade e desempenho.

- Projetar e implementar soluções utilizando Amazon Web Services (AWS), como EC2, S3, RDS e Lambda.

- Colaborar com equipes de design e produto para definir requisitos e especificações das aplicações.

- Participar de revisões de código e garantir melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.

- Implementar e manter processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD).

- Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de desempenho e segurança nas aplicações.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações usando Java.

- Conhecimento prático em AWS e serviços relacionados.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).

- Experiência em frameworks Java, como Spring ou Hibernate.

- Compreensão de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil e metodologias DevOps.

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e colaborar de forma eficaz.

- Conhecimento de ambientes de governança do seguimento financeiro.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento frontend (ex.: React, Angular) é um diferencial.

title: Analista Contábil
description:
Principal Desafio: Garantir a correta apuração, análise e cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e contábeis da empresa, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente, atendimento às auditorias e qualidade nas informações reportadas aos órgãos reguladores e à matriz.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar contabilizações e conciliações contábeis, incluindo processos judiciais
  • Preparar e analisar relatórios contábeis e fiscais (BRGAAP)
  • Atender demandas de auditoria interna e externa
  • Preparar, analisar e reportar informações fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, SPED Contábil, e-LALUR, entre outros)
  • Elaborar balanços patrimoniais conforme legislação societária
  • Revisar reconciliações contábeis (BRGAAP/USGAAP)
  • Monitorar CNDs e acompanhar comunicações nos sistemas E-CAC, Siare e SIGISS
  • Revisar registros contábeis garantindo conformidade com normas e práticas internas
  • Controlar ativos fixos e realizar cálculo mensal de depreciação
  • Gerenciar despesas por centro de custo
  • Atender exigências relacionadas às demonstrações financeiras
  • Acompanhar e orientar processos financeiros e fiscais fora da rotina operacional

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis
  • CRC ativo
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano na área contábil/fiscal
  • Experiência com auditoria externa será um diferencial
  • Inglês intermediário
  • Conhecimento em conciliação contábil
  • Experiência em contabilidade industrial
  • Conhecimento em IFRS
  • Conhecimento em regime especial de ICMS
  • Conhecimento em análise de balanço
  • Conhecimento em cálculo de IRPJ e CSLL
  • Boa capacidade de adaptação a prazos

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Senso de responsabilidade e comprometimento com resultados
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos desafiadores
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes
  • Proatividade e autonomia
  • Trabalho em equipe e compartilhamento de conhecimento
  • Atualização constante sobre legislação fiscal e contábil

title: Customer Success Specialist,Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: AI Engineer Specialist | Full-Stack [Python/Node.js/React]
description:
✨ Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuro


A Getnet é uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de 1,3 milhão de comerciantes com serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce.

Fazemos parte da PagoNxt , a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença em Espanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai .

Nossa missão é clara: simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala , ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade.

Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio.

Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global.


Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.


Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.


✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando um profissional com amplo conhecimento técnico e experiência comprovada em IA Generativa e arquiteturas de agentes autônomos, para atuar na concepção, desenvolvimento e evolução de uma plataforma de agentes, habilitando outras áreas da companhia no desenvolvimento de soluções agenticas.


O que você vai fazer

  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes inteligentes e autônomos baseados em LLMs , capazes de executar tarefas complexas de forma segura e escalável.
  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas avançadas de agent orchestration utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e plataforma de IA Generativa.
  • Desenhar e otimizar fluxos de decisão, memória, planejamento, raciocínio e execução em agentes de IA.
  • Integrar agentes a APIs REST de sistemas externos , com foco em Integrações de soluções corporativas.
  • Garantir observabilidade ponta a ponta , incluindo logging, tracing, métricas e controle de erros em sistemas baseados em agentes.
  • Escrever e revisar código limpo, escalável, resiliente e testável , seguindo padrões de engenharia de alto nível.
  • Contribuir ativamente para decisões estratégicas relacionadas a IA, arquitetura e inovação tecnológica .

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Background em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Forte expertise em IA Generativa e LLMs, incluindo design de soluções agentic.
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada com:

- LangChain

- LangGraph

- Construção de agentes multi-step e multi-agent

  • Domínio de integrações via APIs REST
  • Experiência robusta com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Proficiência em Python e conhecimento em Node.js e React
  • Experiência com aplicações front-end
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Alta capacidade de lidar com problemas complexos, ambíguos e pouco estruturados.
  • Pensamento sistêmico e visão arquitetural.
  • Comunicação clara e eficaz em ambientes multidisciplinares.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade, autonomia e protagonismo técnico.


O que oferecemos

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
About Warmy :)

Warmy.io enhances email deliverability by optimizing domain and IP reputation, ensuring emails land in inboxes instead of spam folders. Our advanced platform simplifies email warming using a unique email seed list.


With integrations like Google Postmaster Tools, Warmy provides actionable insights for superior email performance. Catering to a global audience, Warmy supports email warming in over 30 languages and offers free tools for marketers, such as the Email Deliverability Test and SPF/DMARC Record Generators. Warmy is designed to streamline email deliverability, allowing users to focus on meaningful audience engagement.


Role Description

We are looking for a Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence to own and manage all company analytics. This role is responsible for building a clear view of the business through data, monitoring key metrics on a daily basis, and translating numbers into actionable insights for leadership.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .


Responsabilites:

  • Own the company’s analytics strategy and data visibility across all departments.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.


KPI Monitoring

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border ), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat ) e stablecoins , bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins .
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins , fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Qualificações Preferenciais:

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

  • Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin , VASP , OTC , SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
  • Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.

title: Assistente de Meio Ambiente
description:
Deseja fazer parte da equipe JIMO Química ?



Estamos selecionando candidatos para a vaga: ASSISTENTE DE MEIO AMBIENTE .



Principais atividades:

  • Controlar as condicionantes da licença de operação – FEPAM;
  • Responsável pelas demandas técnicas do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental e por dar suporte a manutenção de certificações ambientais;
  • Realizar o encaminhamento para destinação final de todos os efluentes líquidos, resíduos sólidos recicláveis (classe II) e resíduos sólidos contaminados (classe I), emitindo as respectivas MTR’s;
  • Realizar a comunicação junto a órgãos ambientais (FEPAM, IBAMA) sobre assuntos pertinentes à área ambiental.



Requisitos:

  • Graduação Ambiental (Cursando ou Concluída);
  • Experiência em atividades de meio ambiente no segmento de indústria;
  • Conhecimento em ISO 14001;
  • Gestão de Resíduos;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Conhecimento de Legislação Ambiental.



Competências:

  • Comprometimento;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Iniciativa;
  • Organização.



Diferenciais:

  • Graduação na área Ambiental.



Gostou do desafio? Então participe do processo seletivo!

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
International Assistant Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.

Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles

Process Improvement

  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (LATAM only)

Contract: Full-time (40h/week)

Compensation: USD $14,000 – $18,000 gross per year (depending on experience)

Languages: Fluent English required, with familiarity in French

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

Start Date: ASAP


We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: Gerente de atacado
description:
Head de Atacado Nacional – Expansão Multimarcas

Presencial – Nova Friburgo/RJ

A Kaisan está estruturando mais um ciclo de crescimento nacional através do canal de atacado.

Buscamos um(a) profissional sênior, com experiência comprovada na estruturação de atacado em marcas de moda relevantes no Brasil (grupos de grande porte ou operações nacionais consolidadas).


Missão de estruturar o canal de atacado nacional da Kaisan do zero para escala.om experiência comprovada na estruturação e expansão de atacado


Isso inclui:

  • Definição da política comercial completa (descontos, volumes, metas)
  • Estruturação do calendário de pré-venda por coleção
  • Modelagem de pedido mínimo e curva de compra
  • Organização de fluxo operacional (produção, logística e financeiro)
  • Definição de critérios para seleção de multimarcas
  • Construção e ativação de carteira nacional
  • Implementação de metas regionais
  • Integração estratégica com o canal digital


O perfil que buscamos

  • +10 anos de experiência em moda
  • Experiência real em atacado estruturado de marca relevante
  • Já liderou equipe comercial ou regional
  • Já estruturou política comercial e calendário de coleção
  • Vivência com metas de múltiplos milhões
  • Entendimento profundo de sell-in vs sell-out
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica
  • Perfil executivo, orientado a resultado



Indicadores esperados

  • Estruturação completa do canal em até 90 dias
  • Primeira rodada de pré-venda organizada
  • Carteira ativa inicial validada
  • Modelo escalável implementado
  • Crescimento sustentável do faturamento atacado


O que oferecemos

  • Projeto nacional em forte expansão
  • Marca com alto reconhecimento digital
  • Estrutura produtiva própria
  • Autonomia de construção
  • Remuneração fixa + variável agressiva por performance

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog , estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.
  • Documentação Técnica: Atuar ativamente na criação de catálogos de dados, dicionários, diagramas de linhagem e manuais de processos. A documentação será um pilar central da entrega.
  • Governança de IA: Estabelecer diretrizes para o uso ético e seguro de modelos de IA, monitorando a qualidade dos dados de entrada (inputs) e a rastreabilidade dos modelos.
  • Segurança e Acessos: Definir e gerenciar perfis de acesso, garantindo que a democratização dos dados ocorra de forma segura.
  • Colaboração: Atuar como ponte entre as equipes de Engenharia de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e Stakeholders de negócio para garantir a integridade da informação.


Requisitos Técnicos (Hard Skills)

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks e configuração de Unity Catalog .
  • Conhecimento profundo em SQL e linguagens utilizadas em ambiente de dados (Python ou Scala).
  • Vivência com frameworks de Governança de Dados (DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Catálogo de Dados e Linhagem (Data Lineage).
  • Entendimento de fluxos de MLOps e governança aplicada a modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.


Diferenciais

  • Certificações Databricks (Certified Data Engineer ou similar).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Técnico Químico / Colorista
description:
Sobre a Empresa



A Sherwin-Williams é uma empresa multinacional líder no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países e 80 anos de história no Brasil, nosso compromisso é oferecer as melhores soluções em tintas para as mais diversas finalidades, atendendo às necessidades de nossos clientes com qualidade e inovação.



Sobre o Papel



Estamos em busca de um Técnico Químico I cujas principais serão responsável por realizar o desenvolvimento, ajuste e controle de cores em tintas automotivas e industriais, com ênfase em sólidas (monocromáticas), perolizadas e metálicas. Atuará diretamente no laboratório de desenvolvimento, criando formulações, garantindo reprodutibilidade e suportando áreas como P&D, Qualidade e Produção. Local de atuação: Sumaré / São Paulo.



Responsabilidades



  • Desenvolver novas cores sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas conforme demandas de clientes, tendências de mercado ou projetos internos.
  • Ajustar tonalidade, flop, brilho e efeitos especiais utilizando pigmentos metálicos e perolizados.
  • Realizar correções de cor utilizando espectrofotômetro, software colorimétrico e cabine de luz.
  • Executar testes físico-químicos: viscosidade, brilho, aderência, resistência, densidade, entre outros.
  • Avaliar curvas de cor, diferença ΔE, metálicos e flop no espectrofotômetro.
  • Emitir relatórios técnicos e fichas de formulação.
  • Registrar ajustes, histórico de lotes e parâmetros críticos do processo.
  • Suportar o time de produção em ajustes de tonalidade em escala industrial.
  • Colaborar com Engenharia, Qualidade e Vendas em projetos especiais e atendimento ao cliente.



Qualificações


  • Conhecimentos Essenciais
  • Experiência comprovada em tintas sólidas, perolizadas e metálicas (automotivas, industriais ou repintura).
  • Domínio de espectrofotômetro e softwares colorimétricos (ex.: Datacolor, X-Rite).
  • Conhecimento em pigmentação, dispersão e comportamento de flake metálico e mica perolizada.
  • Leitura e interpretação de curvas de cor e parâmetros Lab*.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em laboratório de P&D.
  • Conhecimento em colorimetria avançada e ajustes complexos (high flop, alto brilho, efeitos especiais).


Formação Acadêmica


  • Técnico em Química (obrigatório).
  • Superior em Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • CRQ ativo.



Experiência Mínima


2 a 5 anos em laboratório de tintas, preferencialmente com foco em cores especiais (metálicas e perolizadas).

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: OPERADOR DE PRODUÇÃO C
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Realizar atividades de linha de produção de produtos embalados: tais como manuseio de embalagens para montagem,
  • Inspeção e colocação em esteira de produção; atividades de fechamento de baldes;
  • Selagens de sacos plásticos, fechamento de caixas, montagem de paletes com produtos acabados e plastificação de paletes.
  • Limpeza das instalações e equipamentos da área produtiva e afins; Preenchimento de planilhas relacionadas as atividades;
  • Organização das áreas produtivas; Garantir os procedimentos de BPF;
  • E outras atividades correlatas ao cargo.


Instrução:

  • Ensino Médio

Diferencial:

  • Atuação em Industrias


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

  • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas, como produto e operações, para garantir que feedbacks dos clientes sejam levados em consideração.

  • Forte domínio de Python para automações, integrações e manipulação de dados;
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial e Modelos Cognitivos de Processamento (MCP);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como QuickSight, Metabase ou similares de nível compatível.
  • Conhecimentos aprofundados em SQL;
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de IA e desenvolvimento de prompts adaptáveis;


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Ensino Superior em Curso nas áreas de Engenharia, Ciências da Computação/Dados, Estatística ou correlatas;
  • Experiência anterior com produtos de tecnologia ou SaaS com ênfase em dados e BI;
  • Experiência prévia com de BI;
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas logísticos ou de e-commerce será um diferencial.


BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Licença Remunerada Anual
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternindade
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Day Off de Aniversário.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .


COMO SE DESTACAR:

Ao se candidatar, envie portfólio, GitHub, dashboards ou cases (mesmo acadêmicos/pessoais) que mostrem, na prática:

  • Construção de pipelines de dados de ponta a ponta (ingestão, transformação, modelagem e consumo).
  • Seu raciocínio técnico nas escolhas de arquitetura, ferramentas e estruturação dos dados.
  • Exemplos de modelagem, SQL, Python e uso de ferramentas como DBT, Athena , orquestradores ou similares.
  • Dashboards e análises com foco em decisão, usabilidade e contexto de negócio.
  • Cuidados com qualidade, rastreabilidade, documentação e manutenção dos pipelines.
  • Casos de integração com APIs, bancos, arquivos ou automações.
  • Como você aprende , evolui tecnicamente e incorpora feedback no dia a dia.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Data Engineer Powercenter (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • +3years of experience as a Data Engineer with Informatica PowerCenter .
  • Strong knowledge of ETL processes and development of complex workflows and data pipelines.
  • Experience with Informatica Cloud / CDI-PC / IICS , including design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud data integration pipelines .
  • Experience in developing integrated solutions and creating complex workflows in a corporate data environment.
  • Ability to plan, monitor, and deliver projects within timelines and budget.
  • Experience in testing, data quality, and defect management.
  • Good command of English.
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal (Porto or Lisbon); eligible for a Portuguese work visa or holding EU/dual nationality.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Executive Assistant | Fully Remote | English Speaking
description:
Brazilstrat connects top-tier Brazilian remote talent with organizations abroad. We are currently selecting an Executive Assistant to join a fast-paced, dynamic international scaleup , supporting the CEO and Founder.


In this role, you will work remotely as a strategic partner to leadership. This is an ideal position for a proactive, organized professional looking to work closely with C-level management in a global environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Excellence: efficiently manage complex calendars, international travel logistics, and inbox triage to ensure the CEO’s day-to-day runs smoothly.
  • Strategic Support: act as a partner to the CEO by leading ad-hoc business projects, conducting market research, and preparing briefing materials to support decision-making.
  • Communication & Reporting: prepare high-quality presentations (decks), reports, and meeting minutes for board meetings and internal strategy sessions.
  • Force Multiplier: facilitate cross-functional communication and handle operational roadblocks, allowing leadership to focus on high-impact strategy.


Requirements:

  • Fluent English (spoken and written) is mandatory.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Tech-savvy: proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and productivity tools like Notion. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively to increase efficiency is highly valued.
  • Proactive mindset: you are a problem solver who addresses issues before they become emergencies.
  • High emotional intelligence and professional discretion.


What We Offer:

  • 100% remote, home-office flexibility.
  • Direct exposure to C-Level leadership and business operations.
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly scaling international company.

Note: Only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

title: [CS] Analista de Customer Success Júnior | Ponto
description:
Atuar na implantação do software, assegurando uma experiência positiva ao cliente desde o início da jornada, com foco na correta configuração do sistema, no cumprimento do escopo contratado e no apoio inicial ao uso da solução. Atuar como referência técnica durante todo o período de implantação, garantindo a adequada parametrização do sistema e apoiando os clientes no aprendizado e na execução dos processos necessários, contribuindo para o sucesso e a satisfação do cliente.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Realizar a implantação do sistema, seguindo metodologia, cronograma e escopo definidos;
  • Conduzir reuniões de kick-off, alinhamento, acompanhamento e finalização com clientes;
  • Atender dúvidas através do e-mail;
  • Apoiar/ensinar o cliente a realizar as configurações do sistema conforme regras de negócio do cliente;
  • Apoiar o cliente na compreensão dos processos e funcionalidades da solução;
  • Garantir fluidez e eficiência nos atendimentos;
  • Registrar atividades, avanços e riscos nos sistemas internos (CRM, ferramentas de CS ou projetos);
  • Identificar, reportar e apoiar para solução com pontos de atenção, riscos de atraso ou insatisfação durante a implantação;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Comercial, Produto, CS Ongoing e Suporte);
  • Garantir a transição adequada do cliente para o pós-implantação (CS e Suporte).


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino superior cursando na área de Tecnologia, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e GSuite - nível básico
  • Vivência média de 01 ano na área de atendimento ao cliente ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável experiência em empresas B2B.

title: Arquiteto Sênior SAP Basis e Infraestrutura
description:
Sobre a Empresa



Você atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).



Sobre o Papel



Procuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.



Responsabilidades



  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers.
  • Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis.
